assumptions: The period analysed is 22–31 Oct 2026, as stated explicitly in the question.
Risk declines mean attempts with failure category risk_decline (issuer risk decline, risk rule decline and suspected fraud).
caveats: Attempt volume in 22–31 Oct was 39% above the usual level for those weekdays. This may reflect a real sale or a data gap, so be careful comparing these counts with other periods.
Rankings are by count of risk declines; BINs with more traffic can rank higher, so the decline rate shown per BIN gives context on how unusual each one is.

facts.text: There were 2,516 risk-decline failed card attempts in 22–31 Oct 2026.
BIN 911001 (Harbor Bank) had the most risk declines: 371, or 14.7% of the total, with 15.7% of its own 2,360 attempts declined for risk.
BIN 911003 (Harbor Bank) was second with 345 risk declines (13.7% of the total), a risk-decline rate of 15.3% on 2,255 attempts.
BIN 911002 (Harbor Bank) was third with 297 risk declines (11.8% of the total), a risk-decline rate of 13.3% on 2,239 attempts.
The top three BINs together made up 40.3% of all risk declines.

The remaining BINs in the top 10 each had 68 to 92 risk declines, with risk-decline rates of 2.4% to 2.6% of their own attempts. Examples: 922002 (Lotus Bank) with 92 declines, 922003 (Lotus Bank) with 91, and 912002 (Harbor Bank) with 76.

response.headline: Three Harbor Bank BINs — 911001, 911003 and 911002 — had the most risk declines in 22–31 Oct 2026, together accounting for 40.3% of all card risk declines.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Break down the risk declines for 911001, 911003 and 911002 by failure code, merchant and day, and check with Harbor Bank whether risk rules changed around 22 Oct.
hypotheses.rationale: Their risk-decline rates (13.3% to 15.7%) are several times higher than the 2.4% to 2.6% seen on other top-10 BINs, which points to something specific to these BINs rather than general volume.
hypotheses.text: The three leading Harbor Bank BINs may be hit by a stricter issuer-side risk rule or a targeted fraud pattern.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The three leading Harbor Bank BINs may be hit by a stricter issuer-side risk rule or a targeted fraud pattern.
recommendations.rationale: These three BINs account for over 40% of all risk declines and have unusually high decline rates.
recommendations.text: Investigate the risk-decline spike on Harbor Bank BINs 911001, 911003 and 911002 with the issuer and your risk team.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: BIN 911001 (Harbor Bank) had the most risk declines: 371, or 14.7% of the total, with 15.7% of its own 2,360 attempts declined for risk.
recommendations.rationale: A rate of about 15% on these BINs could mean lost genuine sales.
recommendations.text: Review whether legitimate customers are being declined on these BINs, for example by sampling declined attempts that later succeeded on retry.
